_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The analyst's forward call to Disbelief is the consensus lean — price recovery with lingering crowd fear fits the ladder climb from Denial — but the 5% base rate for ±2pt moves in coil conditions means HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until a breaker emerges.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both point toward recovery continuation (Disbelief/Hope territory), but the analyst is cautious and coil-aware while the narrative writer is more convictionally bullish on the accumulation thesis; the split is on confidence level and interpretation, not direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed rises above 35 with BTC holding $62K+ and funding staying moderate — signals Hope phase transition
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spiking above 20 and funding flipping negative — drops to Anxiety/Panic leg down
